description: arXiv:2609.23152v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recently proposed self-supervised audio encoders learn powerful general-purpose representations of sound scenes, yet they are spatially blind. To supply the missing spatial representation of sound scenes, we introduce Bearings. Bearings is a self-supervised framework that learns soundfield embeddings from unlabeled first-order Ambisonics.
